android.desc:
Your bank, always at hand with the ING App
Manage your money easily and securely – anytime, anywhere. With the ING App, you handle all your banking needs for both personal and business accounts. From checking your balance to investing: everything in one app.
What you can do with the ING App:
•	Fast and secure payments: confirm transactions with your mobile device.
•	Overview & control: check your balance, scheduled transfers and savings plans.
•	Send payment requests: getting your money back is quick and easy.
•	Look ahead: view up to 35 days of upcoming debits and credits.
•	Custom daily limit: set your own maximum amount per day.
•	All-in-one app: payments, savings, loans, investments, credit card and even your ING insurance.

Manage it yourself in the ING App
From blocking your card to updating your address – you can do it instantly in the ING App. No waiting, no paperwork.

Don’t have an ING account yet?
Easily open a new current account via the ING App. All you need is a valid ID.

What you need to activate the ING App:
•	An ING current account
•	A Mijn ING account
•	A valid ID (passport, EU ID card, Dutch residence permit, Foreign Nationals ID or Dutch driver’s license)

Security first
•	Your banking is done via a secure connection.
•	No personal data is stored on your device.
•	Always use the latest version of the ING App for optimal security and new features.

With the ING App, you’re in control. Download the app and experience the ease of mobile banking.
